note: Real National Weather Service products for Washtenaw County, from the Iowa Environmental Mesonet archive. Text is abridged.

replays.headline: Ice storm warning in effect from noon Wednesday to 4 AM EST Thursday
replays.what: Mixed precipitation expected. Total snow and sleet accumulations of less than one inch and ice accumulations around one tenth of an inch.
replays.impacts: Plan on slippery road conditions. The hazardous conditions could impact the evening commute.

replays.what: At 507 PM EDT...NATIONAL WEATHER SERVICE DOPPLER RADAR INDICATED A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM CAPABLE OF PRODUCING A TORNADO. THIS DANGEROUS STORM WAS LOCATED NEAR PINCKNEY...AND MOVING EAST AT 15 MPH.

replays.headline: Heat advisory in effect from noon today to 8 PM EDT this evening
replays.what: Heat index values up to 102 expected.
replays.impacts: Hot temperatures and high humidity may cause heat illnesses.

replays.headline: High wind warning in effect from 5 AM to 10 PM EDT Friday
replays.what: Southwest winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts 50 to 60 mph expected.
replays.impacts: Damaging winds will blow down trees and power lines. Widespread power outages are expected. Travel will be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.

replays.what: At 950 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line extending from near Hartland to 6 miles south of Stockbridge to near Homer, moving southeast at 45 mph.

replays.headline: Winter storm warning in effect from 3 PM Saturday to 10 AM EST Sunday
replays.what: Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 5 and 7 inches.
